project.description:
Port of the perl-based NCBI-Gene-Load to Java. Reconciles ZFIN <-> NCBI Gene cross-references and RefSeq accessions. Runs `gradle ncbiPort` (= :ncbiLoadPort -> org.zfin.datatransfer.ncbi.NCBIDirectPort) in the Jenkins workspace.
INPUTS (external): ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/refseq/release/RELEASE_NUMBER ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/refseq/release/release-catalog/RefSeq-release<N>.catalog.gz (filtered to 'Danio rerio'; override: OVERRIDE_REFSEQ_CATALOG) ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/DATA/gene2accession.gz (filtered to taxon 7955; override: OVERRIDE_GENE2ACCESSION) ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/DATA/GENE_INFO/Non-mammalian_vertebrates/Danio_rerio.gene_info.gz ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/DATA/ARCHIVE/gene2vega.gz https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi (efetch step, builds seq.fasta for accession lengths; SKIP_EFETCH / FORCE_EFETCH)
INPUTS (produced by sibling tasks, read from $SOURCEROOT): ncbi_matches_through_ensembl.csv (NcbiMatchThroughEnsemblTask) ncbi_gene_symbol_matches.csv (NcbiGeneSymbolMatchTask)
OUTPUT (tables written) - via the SQL files in server_apps/data_transfer/NCBIGENE/: db_link insert new NCBI/RefSeq/GenBank accessions, delete withdrawn ones record_attribution attributions for added/removed links zdb_active_data rows removed for deleted dblinks reference_protein rows tied to deleted dblinks marker_annotation_status full rebuild (DELETE then INSERT) marker_assembly gene <-> assembly rows sequence_feature_chromosome_location_generated genomic locations for newly linked genes gff3_ncbi_attribute attributes for newly linked genes ncbi_gene_load / ncbi_gene_delete / tmp_pre_ncbi_gene_delete staging tables loaded from the .unl files
REFERENCE TABLES (used for matching/protection from deletion): db_link current ZFIN accessions - the core comparison set foreign_db_contains resolves the fdbcont row for each accession type marker / marker_relationship / marker_type_group_member gene identity, EST/clone -> gene traversal, type filtering record_attribution protects curator-attributed links from deletion expression_experiment2 protects dblinks in use by expression data ortholog_external_reference ortholog-side NCBI references external_resource.ncbi_danio_rerio_gene_info_ensembl NCBI -> Ensembl ID map for the one-way-gene matching vocabulary_term NCBI annotation-status vocabulary assembly assembly PK for marker_assembly rows
Full I/O documentation: reference/data-load-jobs.md#ncbi-gene-load-java

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: LOAD_NCBI_ONE_WAY_GENES
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Enable this flag to additionally add NCBI genes that have a link to ZFIN without an equivalent link back from ZFIN to NCBI. These are validated by having a shared ensembl id. See ZFIN-8517 for details.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
# working dir can be set to old path with: # export WORKING_DIR=$TARGETROOT/server_apps/data_transfer/NCBIGENE/
# set working dir to jenkins workspace export WORKING_DIR=$WORKSPACE
# clear the working directory rm -f $WORKING_DIR/*
# optionally, copy the stored load files instead of downloading them # cp /research/zarchive/load_files/NCBI-gene-load-archive/2025-07-30/* $WORKING_DIR
# Some options to skip steps for troubleshooting # SKIP_DOWNLOADS means to use cached local files instead of downloading them # export SKIP_DOWNLOADS=1
# EARLY_EXIT means quit the job before actually running the sql files against the DB (useful for checking expected results in .unl files) # export EARLY_EXIT=1
# SKIP_EFETCH means do not run logic to "efetch" sequences from ncbi endpoint to build seq.fasta file for calculating sequence lengths # export SKIP_EFETCH=1
# FORCE_EFETCH means to force run the efetch logic # export FORCE_EFETCH=1
# Run the gradle task from source directory cd $SOURCEROOT
# Option for troubleshooting: load the database from a backup # gradle loaddb -DB=/research/zunloads/databases/zfindb/2025.07.28.1/2025.07.28.1.bak
# Optionally run liquibase (temporary for now until the DB is updated with the new tables marker_annotation_status, etc.) # gradle liquibasePostBuild
# Run the NCBI gene load gradle ncbiPort
